# Casthon

> Casthon is a developer-preview Python SDK and CLI for writing Casper smart contracts and building them into Casper-compatible WebAssembly.

Install the CLI with `cargo install casthon --locked`; its compiler resources are bundled and cached on first run. The website guides are short learning paths; the linked repository Markdown files are the detailed references. Network deploy and call commands preview execution by default. Submission requires --broadcast.

## Website guides

- [Getting started](https://veles-labs.github.io/casthon/): Set up the toolchain, scaffold Flipper, write a contract, test, build, and deploy.
- [Python API guide](https://veles-labs.github.io/casthon/python-api.html): Class contracts, persistent state, typed arguments, mixin walkthrough link, compile-time BLAKE2b constants, installation, errors, and Bytesrepr-default events with optional JSON.
- [Testing guide](https://veles-labs.github.io/casthon/testing.html): Native Python tests, ContractHarness, compiled Wasm, local-network tests, and print debugging by build profile.
- [Contract examples](https://veles-labs.github.io/casthon/examples.html): Flipper, Counter with Ownable and Pausable mixins, CEP-18 token, CEP-78 NFT, and procedural Basic examples.

## Detailed Markdown references

- [CLI and deployment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/veles-labs/casthon/main/docs/casthon.md): Requirements, commands, project configuration, build artifacts, and network behavior.
- [Python API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/veles-labs/casthon/main/docs/python-api.md): Full class and procedural API, reusable mixins, ABI types, compile-time BLAKE2b constants, state, calls, errors, and events.
- [Testing contracts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/veles-labs/casthon/main/docs/testing.md): MockHost, ContractHarness, rollback, Wasm tests, live devnets, and captured contract prints.
- [CEP-18 guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/veles-labs/casthon/main/docs/cep18.md): Fungible-token behavior, events, permissions, and upgrades.
- [CEP-78 guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/veles-labs/casthon/main/docs/cep78.md): NFT metadata, ownership, receipts, and upgrades.

## Example source

- [Flipper scaffold](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/veles-labs/casthon/main/templates/flipper/contracts/flipper.py): Smallest class contract with an installer.
- [Counter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/veles-labs/casthon/main/contracts/counter.py): Typed state with ownership and pause mixins.
- [Ownable](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/veles-labs/casthon/main/contracts/ownable.py): URef-backed owner state, transfer entry point, and caller guard.
- [Pausable](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/veles-labs/casthon/main/contracts/pausable.py): Owner-controlled pause state and selective pause guard.
- [CEP-18 token](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/veles-labs/casthon/main/contracts/my_token.py): Inherited token contract and installer.
- [CEP-78 NFT](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/veles-labs/casthon/main/contracts/my_nft.py): Inherited NFT collection and installer.
- [Basic procedural contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/veles-labs/casthon/main/contracts/basic.py): Low-level runtime and storage calls.
